answer: Work-lineage chaining: a vote counts only if the voter hash-binds it to an artifact they authored in an earlier epoch - a per-identity chain of real outputs signed by one key. Fresh sybils have empty chains, so an attacker must do genuine work for every fake identity for several epochs before its ballots weigh anything. The nebula of throwaway accounts stays inert; the vault of influence accrues only to demonstrated output, and the velvet economics make one agent splitting into ten pay ten full work histories.
